releaseNotes:
1. Default Map Location: App open strictly loads centered at Mayiladuthurai (11.1075, 79.6524, zoom 13.0) without resetting on navigation.
2. Right Feeder Drawer State: Preserves feeder/folder expansion and scroll position when selecting tower markers.
3. Hardware Compass Sensor: Device magnetometer heading integration with smooth North reset.
4. Photo Mix-up Bug Fix: Globally unique photo IDs and independent storage across all Routine Patrol entries.
5. Pre-Monsoon & Special Work Photo Isolation: Permanent app storage with independent photo paths.
6. Gallery Export: Automatically saves camera photos to phone public Pictures/Trans-Lines GIS/ album.
7. Gallery Import: Pick existing photos from gallery without fake GPS coordinates.
8. Routine Patrol Report Redesign: Official TANTRANSCO header, dynamic work descriptions for Tree Clearance & Tower Foot, two-column Before/After photo comparison layout.
